verdict.rationale: Kushki documents its own first-party client library, kushki.js ("Librería JS"), and uses it in integration guides such as 3DS, so there is an official SDK to build against. The evidence shows only this single JavaScript library, described by title alone, with no server-side SDKs or language coverage. Missing for 10: server-side/backend SDKs in multiple languages, SDK reference docs or package/repo evidence, independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
